name: Caelestia Theme
author: DevStarByte
description: A color theme that follows your Caelestia dots (caelestia-shell). It reads the current scheme from ~/.local/state/caelestia/scheme.json and restyles ByteForge live whenever you change wallpaper or scheme. "Caelestia: Use Caelestia Theme" in the command palette switches to it.
